preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The cooldown period K is between 0 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(task_i is upper-case English letter for task_i in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task is represented by an upper-case English letter.

postconditions.description: The result is an integer representing the minimum unit of time required to complete all tasks.
The minimum unit of time required to complete all tasks is at least as many as the number of tasks.
The result is optimal, considering the cooldown period and the frequency of tasks.
